def evolved_dxe(logits_local, targets, V_local, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    """1-AR distributed CE: direct exp, single-compare in_shard, fuse into one REDUCE_SUM."""
    local_sum_exp = logits_local.exp().sum(dim=-1)
    target_local = targets - rank * V_local
    target_local_safe = target_local.clamp(0, V_local - 1)
    in_shard = (target_local_safe == target_local)
    local_target = logits_local.gather(1, target_local_safe.unsqueeze(1)).squeeze(1)
    local_target = local_target * in_shard.to(local_target.dtype)
    stacked = torch.stack([local_sum_exp, local_target], dim=0)
    reduced = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, stacked)
    return (reduced[0].log() - reduced[1]).mean()
